paper_title: π-Extended chlorinated non-fullerene acceptors for achieving high performance organic solar cells

knowledge_points.content: The study utilizes a planar and rigid skeleton known as FDICT (fluorene-based central core) as the electron-donating core for A–D–A type non-fullerene acceptors.
knowledge_points.evidence: Fluorene as a planar and rigid skeleton is widely available and has been applied to the fused ring NFAs by our group to construct a FDICT central core.

knowledge_points.content: Combining π-extension and chlorination of the end group in NFAs leads to narrowed molecular bandgaps and red-shifted absorption spectra towards the near-infrared region.
knowledge_points.evidence: Extending the conjugation of the end group narrows the molecular bandgaps and enables a lower Eloss... the onset absorption of F'-N2Cl redshifts significantly towards the NIR region with respect to that of other F-series NFAs.

knowledge_points.content: The organic solar cell based on the PM6:F'-N2Cl blend achieved a maximum power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 14.13%, with an open-circuit voltage (Voc) of 0.927 V, a short-circuit current (Jsc) of 20.31 mA cm⁻², and a fill factor (FF) of 74.68%.
knowledge_points.evidence: this system exhibits the highest power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 14.13% with a Jsc of 20.31 mA cm−2, a Voc of 0.927 V and a FF of 74.68%.

knowledge_points.content: The optical bandgaps (Eg^opt) for the NFAs F'-2Cl, F'-NCl, and F'-N2Cl are 1.574 eV, 1.568 eV, and 1.552 eV, respectively, demonstrating that π-extension and increased chlorination systematically reduce the bandgap.
knowledge_points.evidence: F'-2Cl, F'-NCl and F'-N2Cl films show onset absorption peaks at 788, 791, and 799 nm, corresponding to optical bandgaps (Eg^opt) of 1.574, 1.568, and 1.552 eV, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: Total energy loss (Eloss) in PM6:F'-N2Cl and PM6:F'-NCl systems was reduced to 0.706 eV and 0.686 eV, respectively, compared to 0.725 eV for the PM6:F'-2Cl system.
knowledge_points.evidence: the total Eloss s of OSCs can be calculated based on the following equation: Eloss = (Eg − qVoc), being 0.725, 0.686 and 0.706 eV for PM6:F'-2Cl, PM6:F'-NCl and PM6:F'-N2Cl, respectively

knowledge_points.content: Non-radiative recombination losses (ΔE3) for F'-NCl and F'-N2Cl based devices are as low as 0.277 eV and 0.272 eV, respectively, which are lower than the 0.283 eV observed for F'-2Cl.
knowledge_points.evidence: The greatly suppressed nonradiative recombination with much reduced ΔE3 of 0.272 and 0.277 eV has been achieved by PM6:F'-N2Cl and PM6:F'-NCl based OSCs, respectively, in sharp comparison to that of 0.283 eV for PM6:F'-2Cl

knowledge_points.content: Urbach energy (Eu), a measure of energetic disorder, was determined using high-resolution Fourier transform photocurrent spectra (FTPS-EQE) to be 30.3 meV for PM6:F'-N2Cl and 31.2 meV for PM6:F'-NCl.
knowledge_points.evidence: PM6:F'-N2Cl and PM6:F'-NCl based devices afford slightly smaller Eus of 30.3 and 31.2 meV, respectively, compared to 32.4 meV of the PM6:F'-2Cl based one.

knowledge_points.content: GIWAXS analysis revealed that F'-N2Cl exhibits a compact π–π stacking distance of 3.48 Å in neat films and 3.51 Å in blend films with PM6, with a predominant face-on orientation.
knowledge_points.evidence: the π-π stacking distance (d010) are 3.50, 3.52 and 3.48 Å... the (010) peaks of PM6:F'-2Cl, PM6:F'-NCl and PM6:F'-N2Cl are located at 1.77, 1.75 and 1.79 Å−1, corresponding to a π-π stacking distance (d010) of 3.55, 3.58 and 3.51 Å, respectively.

knowledge_points.content: The hole and electron mobilities (μh/μe) for the PM6:F'-N2Cl blend were measured by SCLC to be 1.01 × 10⁻⁴ and 3.38 × 10⁻⁴ cm² V⁻¹ s⁻¹, respectively, showing a more balanced ratio than the F'-NCl system.
knowledge_points.evidence: PM6:F'-N2Cl photoactive layers exhibit overall ungraded hole/electron mobility (μh/μe) of 1.01 × 10−4/3.38 × 10−4 cm2 V−1 s−1... better than that of PM6:F'-NCl based blends (0.96 × 10−5/2.98 × 10−4 cm2 V−1 s−1).

knowledge_points.content: The optimal organic solar cell devices were fabricated using an inverted structure (ITO/ZnO/PFN-Br/Active layer/MoO3/Ag) with chlorobenzene as the solvent, a 1:1 donor-to-acceptor ratio, and 0.3% DIO as an additive.
knowledge_points.evidence: OSC devices with an inverted architecture of indium tin oxide (ITO)/ZnO/PFN-Br/Active layers/MoO3/Ag were fabricated... optimal conditions are as follows: chlorobenzene is selected as the solvent and the best D : A ratio is 1:1 with 0.3% DIO as additives.

knowledge_points.content: The synthesized NFAs F'-2Cl, F'-NCl, and F'-N2Cl demonstrate high thermal stability with decomposition temperatures (5% weight loss) exceeding 340 °C.
knowledge_points.evidence: all NFAs of F'-2Cl, F'-NCl and F'-N2Cl possess high thermal stability with thermal decomposition onset temperatures (5% mass loss) greater than 340 °C.

knowledge_points.content: The crystal coherence length (CCL) of the (010) π–π stacking in PM6:F'-N2Cl blend films is 26.80 Å, which is significantly larger than that of PM6:F'-2Cl (19.44 Å), contributing to improved electron transport.
knowledge_points.evidence: the coherence lengths of the π-π stacking (CCL010) for PM6:F'-2Cl, PM6:F'-NCl and PM6:F'-N2Cl blends... being 19.44, 25.04 and 26.80 Å, respectively. The slightly enlarged CCL in the PM6:F'-N2Cl blend... resulting in better electron transport properties
